html: Regular prenatal care helps you and your care team keep track of your health and your baby's development. Your first visit is usually scheduled around 8 weeks of pregnancy.

• Health history and physical exam
  • Blood and urine tests
  • Estimating your due date
  • Discussing screening tests

• Take a prenatal vitamin with folic acid
  • Avoid alcohol, tobacco and recreational drugs
  • Ask before starting or stopping any medicine
  • Rest and stay hydrated
Call your care team for heavy bleeding, severe belly pain, high fever, or severe vomiting that keeps you from keeping fluids down.
